source_text: Empirical health outcomes further delineate the practices: randomized controlled trials demonstrate that male circumcision, including khitan when performed medically, reduces heterosexual HIV acquisition by approximately 60%, lowers urinary tract infection rates in infancy by up to 90%, and decreases risks of penile cancer and certain sexually transmitted infections like herpes (28-34% reduction). [66] [97]
